notes.title: 1.6 Duck Invasion update
notes.notes:
1.6 Duck Invasion Update is here!

The rubber ducks have invaded Muffinski!  It is up to you to help stop their plan of world domination!

Added:

- Ducks will randomly appear in the office, however they are not there for long.  You have to find them and click on them.

- Four new achievements!

- A Quack sound.

- A new (bad) ending!

notes.title: 1.3 Update!
notes.notes:
Yes, as in accordance with the Glorious Leader, 1.3 is now live!

Updated Unity Engine,
Game phone now has more phone calls.

notes.title: Linux Version
notes.notes:
Version 1.2bFull

Just uploaded the Linux version, although it works okay our end, it hasnt had a full field test so to speak.

So if you do use Linux and willing to give it go, be great to hear any feedback or issues your having.

notes.title: First Patch!
notes.notes:
Version: Full 1.2

Whats been changed?

- Re-arranged paperwork screen, made the Correct / Wrong notification viewable.

Whats been added?

- Hard Mode! Complete the game to unlock this!
- 5 More Achievements for you too find!

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Version: Full 1.1

This will be the first release! Getting ready for 12pm GMT!

Woot!

notes.title: Balancing Update
notes.notes:
Version: beta0.950

Whats happened in Muffinski this time, well here we go:

- Balancing the game so it starts to get harder mid to late game, Rent increase etc.
- Added Visual cues if a player is right or wrong with paperwork.
- The amazing #1 song by Glorious Ladies Love Glorious Leader now added for your (un)enjoyment!

notes.title: Another Little Update
notes.notes:
Version: beta0.900

Big number jump as not much left now!

Whats been added?

- Save and Load system.  Game auto saves at the end of each day, you'll have the option to continue from the main menu.

notes.title: Another Update
notes.notes:
We are now at Version: beta0.500

Whats new?

Radio voices now added! (Thanks to wifey)

notes.title: A wee update
notes.notes:
Current Version is now: beta0.300

Whats been fixed:

- Removed exploit that enabled player to do two jobs at the same time.
- Made sure all upgrades applied for all missions, not just those off the job board.

notes.title: Office Update
notes.notes:
The general look of the office has been updated, new assets added.

Some general bug fixing.

notes.title: Another little update.
notes.notes:
Alpha version: 0.9

No real fixes, however all the newspaper pictures have been added in.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes:
The original build it was possible, with the right combo of upgrades early on to abuse the income system.
Hopefully this will put that to rest.

The music also loops now, so yay?
